tasks.short: Update professional skills through conferences and seminars

steps.what: Find relevant conferences and seminars and read their programmes
Choose conference sessions that address professional knowledge gaps
Enter the registration details for the selected conference or seminar
Submit the final conference or seminar registration
Attend conferences and seminars and engage with the teaching
Write learning notes and reflect on relevance to practice
Record completed professional learning and attach attendance evidence

tasks.design: Use a native bookmarked learning-event view and contextual completion form in {LMS}. Event selection, external registration, attendance and reflective notes stay human; only event lookup and repeated completion identifiers become shorter.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding programmes and repeating event details interrupt a largely personal learning activity.
tasks.enabler_now: Native learning links and contextual completion forms can remove some navigation and repeated entry.
tasks.still_hard: The practitioner must judge whether a new technique is credible and relevant.
tasks.human_edge: Practical experience is needed to connect conference teaching to patient needs.
tasks.altitude: Professional learning remains personal, with slightly less administration.

reach.task: Compare new rehabilitation techniques with current practice

evidence.claim: Native learning links and contextual completion forms can reduce navigation and repeated event identifiers; no attendance or learning saving is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary includes selection, pre-event registration, attendance, actual learning notes and post-event completion entry in time order. Travel, if present, is unchanged and would lower the relative administrative gain.

The organiser produces event title, date, programme and registration terms as part of its existing event offer. The practitioner reads them in s1, captures registration details in s3 and checks the actual submission in s4; no free structured event feed is assumed.

The organiser supplies attendance evidence only after attendance. The practitioner captures date, event, learning hours and evidence reference in s7; missing evidence requires manual follow-up and ordinary entry, not an inferred completion flag.

Test native links and completion forms before code. Reflective note writing remains full-time because a template does not replace reflection. Savings concern repeated identifiers, not the internal save.
unknowns: Whether event details are already linked
research_questions: Does contextual completion entry reduce work after evidence capture remains counted?

already_counted.description: Registration capture and submission checking, reflection and completion capture remain counted.

incremental.description: Keep event links and completion fields usable.

approvals.approved_version: Exact event, attendee, date, fee or commitment and organiser destination checked before s4 submission; changes invalidate the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100, R97, gross3 minus1 upkeep gives net2. Range0-0.5 assumes small avoidable lookup and repeated completion fields; attendance, note writing and registration remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Research new construction and uses of orthopedic and prosthetic devices

steps.what: Read research on orthopedic and prosthetic construction and use
Design the device research method and record comparison criteria
Construct research prototypes and investigate their properties and possible uses
Record and check prototype measurements and observation details
Calculate repeatable comparisons of device properties
Interpret results and write the research findings and limitations

tasks.design: Use native {SPREADSHEET} calculation templates for repeatable comparisons after the practitioner checks prototype data. Literature appraisal, research design, construction, observation capture, interpretation and written findings remain human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated comparison arithmetic can consume time after the observations are captured.
tasks.enabler_now: Native formulas and reusable tables can reproduce protocol-defined calculations.
tasks.still_hard: A bench result does not establish safe or effective patient use.
tasks.human_edge: The practitioner understands fit, materials and the limits of the research evidence.
tasks.altitude: Less repeat calculation; experimental and clinical judgement remain unchanged.

reach.task: Explain functional needs relevant to a new device concept

evidence.claim: Protocol-defined prototype comparisons can use native spreadsheet formulas without a model; the research workflow and labour estimate are model knowledge.

assumptions: Scenario is exploratory literature and bench-prototype research, not a new patient trial or authorisation for clinical use. Boundary includes actual data recording and written findings.

The practitioner writes comparison definitions, units and exclusions in s2, produces observations in s3 and captures prototype id, test condition, value, unit and observation time in s4 at full time. No free structured experiment or suitability flag is assumed.
s5 formulas produce tables only from the checked dataset. Missing units, incompatible tests or unclear protocol rules return to manual calculation and interpretation.

Test native formulas and reusable tables before code. Record and findings templates are considered but receive no saving here because interpretation and actual capture dominate. Already automatic arithmetic and internal saves earn no new saving.
unknowns: Research scope and actual bench-testing time
research_questions: Can repeat comparison tables reproduce manually verified results without adding cleaning work?

already_counted.description: Protocol writing, data capture, interpretation and written findings remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain calculation templates and test them after protocol changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100, R90, gross10 minus3 upkeep gives net7. Range0-4 assumes some repeated arithmetic is currently manual; all research design, prototypes, records and interpretation remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Publish or present orthopedic and prosthetic research findings

steps.what: Select verified research findings and sources for publication or presentation
Write the argument outline and identify important research limitations
Draft the research manuscript or presentation explanations

loop.purpose: Express the researcher's selected findings and argument
loop.input: Outline, verified findings, analysis tables and source references
loop.output: Editable manuscript or speaker-text draft with source links
loop.check: Practitioner checks quantitative claims, causal wording, device implications and limitations against the actual research
loop.stop: One correction then manual writing for unsupported or distorted claims
loop.why_not_simpler: A layout template cannot express the specific research argument

steps.what: Format the research manuscript or conference presentation
Check final research content, references and disclosure details
Submit the final research manuscript or conference materials
Present research findings and answer conference questions

tasks.design: Use bounded prose drafting and native venue templates in {DOCS} for the manuscript or presentation. The practitioner checks the final content, submits that version through {PARTNER_PORTAL} and personally presents and answers questions where applicable.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing and formatting repeat work after the findings and argument are selected.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-bound drafting and native document styles can assist those preparation steps.
tasks.still_hard: Publication requires accurate claims and honest limits on device implications.
tasks.human_edge: The researcher understands what the evidence supports and can defend it in discussion.
tasks.altitude: More preparation time can go to checking the argument; research accountability stays unchanged.

reach.task: Check that shared research materials expose no unnecessary patient details
reach.learn: Source traceability and careful research disclosure

evidence.claim: Source-bound drafting and native venue templates can assist research communication; no study in this digest measures this task's labour saving.

assumptions: Boundary includes written publication or presentation preparation, formatting, final checking, actual submission and live delivery. Alternative publication and conference paths are averaged; no live delivery time is removed.

Completed research findings and tables come from the original research workflow, including its time-counted data capture and interpretation. Here the practitioner selects findings in s1 and writes the argument in s2; no free communication-ready manuscript is assumed.

The outline identifies claims, table references, limitations and intended audience. Native formatting in s4 consumes s3 text and venue styles; missing source links or uncertain findings return to manual writing.

Test native styles and reusable venue templates first. No invented references are accepted. Same-system saves earn no saving or self-gate; submission and prepared presentation have final-version gates.
research_questions: Does checked drafting preserve quantitative findings and limits on clinical implications?

already_counted.description: Outline writing, draft correction, final checks and submission checks remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain venue templates and check source and drafting failures.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final manuscript or materials, attachments, disclosure details and venue destination checked before s6 submission; changes void the check.
Exact prepared presentation version, findings and intended conference audience checked in s5; changed prepared content requires another check before s7 delivery.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100, R80, gross20 minus5 upkeep gives net15. Range3-8 assumes real manual prose and venue formatting remain; live presentation, findings selection and final checks stay human.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Professional learning and research judgement stay personal while selected native views, calculations and document preparation reduce repetitive work.
reach: Discuss functional research needs with physical therapists
Check research disclosure with medical records specialists
role.ambitious_version: A practitioner with less repeated research administration and more time for evaluating evidence and practical device questions.
